description: 🚀 The fast, Pythonic way to build MCP servers and clients.

sources.entry: fastmcp - A high-level, Pythonic framework for building MCP servers and clients.

summary.one_liner: FastMCP is a Python framework for building Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers, clients, and interactive apps using ordinary decorated functions.
summary.what_it_does: The README shows a server built by decorating a Python function with @mcp.tool, with the schema, validation, and documentation generated from the function signature and docstring. The framework has three pillars: Servers (expose tools, resources, and prompts to LLMs), Apps (give tools interactive UIs rendered in the conversation), and Clients (connect to local or remote MCP servers, programmatically or via CLI). Clients handle transport negotiation, authentication, and protocol lifecycle when given a URL. Documentation is published at gofastmcp.com, with llms.txt and llms-full.txt versions for coding agents. The README also mentions a TypeScript counterpart, FastMCP for TypeScript, published as @prefecthq/fastmcp-ts. It also promotes Prefect Horizon, a separate enterprise MCP gateway, which is not part of this repository.
use_cases: building an MCP server from Python functions
exposing tools and data to LLMs
connecting an agent to remote MCP servers
creating interactive UIs for LLM tool results
testing MCP servers from the command line
upgrading from older FastMCP or MCP SDK versions
how_to_run: Define a server: from fastmcp import FastMCP; mcp = FastMCP("Demo"); decorate functions with @mcp.tool
Run the server with mcp.run() under if __name__ == "__main__"
notable: Generates tool schemas, validation, and docs automatically from Python type hints and docstrings
Covers servers, clients, and interactive apps in one framework
Ships llms.txt and llms-full.txt documentation for coding agents
Official TypeScript counterpart FastMCP for TypeScript from the same team
Documented upgrade guides from FastMCP 2, FastMCP 3, and MCP SDK v1/v2
caveats: The README does not describe platform limits or runtime requirements beyond installation with uv
Prefect Horizon, the enterprise gateway with SSO, RBAC and audit logs, is a separate commercial product and is not part of this repository
llms-full.txt may exceed LLM context windows
keywords: alternative to official mcp python sdk
